_about: The Interlude (docs/INTERLUDE.md): the historical chapter 25 years before the campaign, in the city the party later explores as the Ruins. Read by engine/world/Interlude.cpp. The party's final builds, the maps and Salazar's quests come from the user; the values here are first values.
_requiredQuests: Salazar's quest ids (content/engine2/overworld.json quests) that must all be done before the Ruins open. EMPTY = the Ruins stay shut (an unconfigured gate never opens by accident). Modo teste, and the developer flag "interlude:ruins-open" in save.flags, open them for testing.
_missions: The chapter's maps in order (mission id = map id in content/maps/ember, the newest serial plays). TEMPORARY: one placeholder map until the user's Interlude maps arrive.
